messages:
Lina Gomez: Hey team - planning a 4-month stay in Warsaw (2026-05-15 to 2026-09-14). Staying on Redwood payroll. Do I need to change homebase or will temporary remote cover this?
Ravi Shah: You can remain on US homebase for up to 6 months under the temporary remote policy, but we need the signed addendum and approval.
Lina Gomez: Got it. Also, WFH stipend is $200/mo — will that continue while Im in Poland?
Payroll Bot: Policy note: "WFH stipend continues for approved temporary international remote work up to 6 months. Paid monthly in USD by default."
Lina Gomez: Cool. Would prefer USD. Any complications with shipping a monitor to Poland?
Ops Logistics: We can ship from EU hub to avoid customs if requested 10 business days ahead. If we provide equipment, we may reconcile its value against stipend months.
Benefits Team: Heads-up: US medical covers telemedicine overseas but in-person care may be out-of-network. For stays >90 days we open a benefits exception review.
Ravi Shah: Also note: Polands 183-day rule normally wont apply for ~4 months, but keep dates documented. If you start receiving local payments or change bank to PLN that creates payroll nexus.
Lina Gomez: Thanks — Ill sign the addendum and keep US payroll + USD stipend. Ops, will DM for EU-hub shipping.
Payroll Bot: Please update temporary address with payroll for withholding accuracy.
